title: GAE-Δ: Phenotype-Specific Gene Role Shifts in Multi-Omics Data via Graph Autoencoder Embedding Differences
description: GAE-Δ trains group-specific graph autoencoders on phenotype-stratified gene interaction networks and uses the difference between the learned gene embeddings to identify genes whose network role shifts between phenotypic groups, integrating RNA-seq, DNA methylation, and CNV via late fusion.
